notes: Easy cap branches downgrade S/S+-like candidates to 3 and set the warning flag.
This likely maps to A in many result contexts, but keep the label conservative until all grade enums are mapped.
Observed as reward context / rank parameter when the tester received S rank everywhere after bypassing the Easy cap.
Compared by result rank code as an S+ candidate before Easy-only downgrade branches.

time_or_lower_is_better.description: Reads selector 0 from row+0x64 and compares a float value against five u32 threshold columns. Lower values return better rank candidates.

count_or_higher_is_better.description: Reads selector 1 from row+0x64 and compares a normalized u32 value against five u32 threshold columns. Higher values return better rank candidates.

merge_helper.description: Merges two sub-ranks by mapping each rank through DAT_141953390, reading fixed_owner+0x20+0x1048 score entries, scaling by 0.001, summing both scores, then comparing against grade target indexes ending at DAT_1419533bc.
notes: The global rank is score-weighted, not a simple min/max of time and count sub-ranks.
Future rank.map_global_rank or rank.override_thresholds APIs should keep threshold edits separate from merge policy.

easy_rankable_patch.description: Bypassing the Easy-only downgrade branches allows Easy missions to award S/S+ and the matching reward bonus.
